claims.claim_text: Republicans characterize their gender-policy agenda as ending what they call left-wing gender insanity.
Republicans would reverse what they characterize as President Biden's radical rewrite of Title IX education regulations.
Republicans would implement voter identification, paper ballots, citizenship proof and same-day voting to secure U.S. elections.
The named U.S. territories are characterized as vitally important to U.S. national security.
Republicans welcome greater participation by those territories throughout the U.S. political process.
Republicans characterize Biden-administration foreign policy as weak, making Americans less safe and damaging U.S. international standing.
Republicans would pursue their peace-through-strength agenda by rebuilding the U.S. military and alliances.
Republicans would secure the U.S. homeland and borders.
Republicans would revive the U.S. defense industrial base.
Republicans commit to building a larger and stronger U.S. military.
